blockers.root_cause: Phases 4, 6, and 7 migrated Soundness.lean, InterSystem/AxiomSubsumption.lean, InterSystem/IntToClassical.lean, and the 15 instance registrations (Instances/*.lean) to consume SchemaUnion via the bridge equivalences, but Systems/*/Completeness.lean (a distinct file family: d_canonical_serial / canonical_trans / *_truth_lemma / *_completeness) was never in scope for any prior phase and is not listed in Phase 8's 'Files to modify' section. These files construct axiom-predicate witnesses directly via the inductive's constructors (both named and anonymous dot-notation) -- exactly the class of site the Phase 8.2 grep-confirm step exists to catch before redefinition. If any <Sys>Axiom/ModalAxiom is redefined as abbrev/def := SchemaUnion sysTags while these call sites still stand, '<Sys>Axiom.implyK' (and the equivalent anonymous '.implyK') becomes an unresolvable dot-notation projection -- a hard compile failure across all 15 systems' Completeness.lean files, not a warning.
blockers.what_was_tried: Ran the plan-mandated grep across Cslib/ for '<Sys>Axiom.' and 'ModalAxiom.' patterns (excluding each system's own Instances/*.lean and SchemaBridges.lean, where such patterns are expected/already migrated). Cross-checked the intuitionistic/minimal/constructive-family hits (CS5ModalAxiom, IS4ModalAxiom, MS4ModalAxiom, ITModalAxiom, IS5ModalAxiom, MS5ModalAxiom, MTModalAxiom, CS4ModalAxiom, CTModalAxiom) and confirmed they are a SEPARATE, out-of-scope inductive family (per Postmortem Constraints, not to be touched) rather than false positives on the classical 15. Read the generic lemma signatures (d_canonical_serial, d_truth_lemma in Systems/D/Completeness.lean) and confirmed they are parameterized over an abstract Axioms : Proposition Atom -> Prop and take predicate-shaped hypotheses -- the failure is specifically the caller's constructor-shaped witness supply, not the generic lemma's own signature. Did NOT perform a live break-and-revert build experiment (would have required editing an Instances/*.lean inductive on a shared, concurrently-committing working tree merely to reproduce an outcome that is unambiguous from Lean's dot-notation-resolution semantics: Foo.bar requires a literally declared Foo.bar constant, and none exists once Foo is a def/abbrev rather than an inductive with a bar constructor).
blockers.what_is_needed: A dedicated migration of all 15 Systems/*/Completeness.lean files from direct-constructor / anonymous-dot-notation witness supply to the SchemaUnion existential-witness form already established as house style in IntToClassical.lean and the Phase-7 private helpers, i.e. '⟨.implyK, by decide, φ, ψ, rfl⟩ : SchemaUnion sysTags (...)' in place of 'D4Axiom.implyK φ ψ' / '.implyK φ ψ'. This is naturally either (a) a new sub-phase inserted before 8.2 redefinition (e.g. 8.1.5), or (b) folded into 8.2's scope with an expanded file list -- but is NOT something this dispatch should do silently, since it is unplanned scope (15 files, none listed in Phase 8's 'Files to modify') and the plan-compliance rule requires escalating a would-be plan deviation rather than substituting a different step. Recommend the user/orchestrator revise the plan to add this sub-phase explicitly before the next 8.2 dispatch.
